question: Find the mailing street address and school name of the school with the lowest SAT excellence rate among those that are locally funded and have an enrollment difference (K-12 minus ages 5–17) greater than the average such difference across all locally funded schools.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_053", T2."XCL_047"
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_041"
INNER JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_030"
WHERE T2."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1."XCL_019" - T1."XCL_024") > (
    SELECT AVG(T4."XCL_019" - T4."XCL_024")
    FROM frpm AS T4
    INNER JOIN schools AS T5 ON T4."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_041"
    WHERE T5."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
  )
ORDER BY CAST(T3."XCL_040" AS REAL) / T3."XCL_036" ASC
LIMIT 1
